blocks.orig: The African View Lodge is a stone’s throw away from Arusha National Park. This charming lodge offers 20 rooms with private bathrooms and stunning views of Mount Meru. The reception, restaurant, and bungalows of African View Lodge are clad with banana leaves in a traditional Mount Meru style. The tropical garden with its wide swimming pool adds to a harmonious overall impression. The chefs prepare lovely dishes with fresh ingredients and the sundowner on the Meru View platform completes the picture.
blocks.html: Just a stone’s throw from Arusha National Park, you’ll find The African View Lodge. This charming lodge has 20 rooms, each with a private bathroom and beautiful views of Mount Meru. Its reception, restaurant and bungalows are covered with banana leaves in the traditional Mount Meru style. A tropical garden with a broad swimming pool adds to the harmonious feel of the place. The chefs cook tasty dishes using fresh ingredients, and a sundowner on the Meru View platform rounds it all off.
